rationale.oversight-explanation: Complete agent debates and score breakdowns support informed human interpretation.
rationale.ai-review: Adversary and cross-provider arbitrator evaluate and challenge candidate assessments.
rationale.risk-routing: Bias, disagreement, and data-quality signals trigger priority enhanced human review.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandatory review gates, override authority, and interruption controls enable human action.
rationale.oversight-theater: It rejects nominal HITL and monitors reviewers for rubber-stamping.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Architecture explicitly maps controls to EU AI Act oversight requirements.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Tamper-evident logs preserve inputs, agent outputs, reviewer identity, and decisions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes score dashboards and procedural HITL as meaningful oversight.
